# Lemonn app · L3

> The Lemonn trading app rebuilt flow by flow from the Figma designs with the Lemonnade V3 (L3) design system (@ `8f81c75`). Each flow below is ONE self-contained markdown file — spec, screens, navigation and all its source — written so an AI agent can convert it to Flutter, iOS or web.

Start with [CONVERT.md](https://kirtanyak-pe.github.io/lemonn-app-prototype/CONVERT.md) (how to convert a flow), then open the flow you were given.

## Flows

- [First deposit](https://kirtanyak-pe.github.io/lemonn-app-prototype/flows/deposit.md): Add money over UPI after account setup: amount, UPI app, confirmation, receipt or failure. — 5 screens · [json](https://kirtanyak-pe.github.io/lemonn-app-prototype/flows/deposit.json) · [prototype](https://kirtanyak-pe.github.io/lemonn-app-prototype/#/flow/deposit)
- [Account setup](https://kirtanyak-pe.github.io/lemonn-app-prototype/flows/kyc.md): KYC after login: PAN, details and declarations, nominee, bank account and F&O activation. — 20 screens · [json](https://kirtanyak-pe.github.io/lemonn-app-prototype/flows/kyc.json) · [prototype](https://kirtanyak-pe.github.io/lemonn-app-prototype/#/flow/kyc)
- [Login](https://kirtanyak-pe.github.io/lemonn-app-prototype/flows/login.md): Welcome, mobile number + OTP, fingerprint, PIN and email — where the app starts. — 9 screens · [json](https://kirtanyak-pe.github.io/lemonn-app-prototype/flows/login.json) · [prototype](https://kirtanyak-pe.github.io/lemonn-app-prototype/#/flow/login)
- [Market](https://kirtanyak-pe.github.io/lemonn-app-prototype/flows/market.md): The Market tab — stock lists (all, gainers, losers, under ₹100 / ₹500) and Filters. — 8 screens · [json](https://kirtanyak-pe.github.io/lemonn-app-prototype/flows/market.json) · [prototype](https://kirtanyak-pe.github.io/lemonn-app-prototype/#/flow/market)
- [Search](https://kirtanyak-pe.github.io/lemonn-app-prototype/flows/search.md): Search stocks, F&O contracts, mutual funds and IPOs; Smart Options & Futures lists; add to watchlist. — 23 screens · [json](https://kirtanyak-pe.github.io/lemonn-app-prototype/flows/search.json) · [prototype](https://kirtanyak-pe.github.io/lemonn-app-prototype/#/flow/search)
- [Stocks](https://kirtanyak-pe.github.io/lemonn-app-prototype/flows/stocks.md): The Stocks tab — the home after login: indices, holdings, products, movers, watchlists, ideas. — 7 screens · [json](https://kirtanyak-pe.github.io/lemonn-app-prototype/flows/stocks.json) · [prototype](https://kirtanyak-pe.github.io/lemonn-app-prototype/#/flow/stocks)

## Design system

- [Lemonnade V3 for agents](https://kirtanyak-pe.github.io/lemonnade-v3-docs/llms.txt): every component, prop, token and rule the flows use.
